t: Erythema - Wikipedia
s: August 28, 2025 - It can be caused by infection, massage, electrical treatment, acne medication, allergies, psoriasis, mast cell activation syndrome (MCAS), exercise, solar radiation (sunburn), photosensitization, acute radiation syndrome, mercury toxicity, blister agents, niacin administration, or waxing and tweezing of the hairs—any of which can cause the affected capillaries to dilate, resulting in redness.
